items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] George. ... [INTERVIEWER] George Douglas. Uh-huh. [INTERVIEWEE] Over there, there were quite a few bands there. ... [INTERVIEWER] George Douglas played which instrument? [INTERVIEWEE] He played trombone.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Douglas Orchestra. And Joe Jesse Orchestra. That's when during that time. Stay there.
What about Douglas' full name? Do you remember that?
